hints.title: Interval Step Cost Formulation
hints.text: Visiting all fruits between positions L and R requires traversing the span plus the distance to the closer endpoint.

hints.title: Turnaround Optimization
hints.text: The total movement steps equal R minus L plus the minimum of distance to L and distance to R from startPos.

hints.title: Sliding Window Invariant
hints.text: Expand the right edge of the window and advance the left edge whenever the required step budget exceeds k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxTotalFruits(self, fruits: list[list[int]], startPos: int, k: int) -> int:
        n = len(fruits)
        left = 0
        total_fruits = 0
        max_fruits = 0

        for right in range(n):
            total_fruits += fruits[right][1]

            while left <= right:
                pos_l = fruits[left][0]
                pos_r = fruits[right][0]
                dist = (pos_r - pos_l) + min(abs(startPos - pos_l), abs(startPos - pos_r))
                if dist <= k:
                    break
                total_fruits -= fruits[left][1]
                left += 1

            max_fruits = max(max_fruits, total_fruits)

        return max_fruits
```

complexity.time: O(N) two pointer sliding window on fruit positions
complexity.notes: The step cost for interval [L, R] around startPos is (R - L) + min(|startPos - L|, |startPos - R|).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all combinations of left and right step lengths takes quadratic or cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window advances right endpoint and shrinks left endpoint while step cost exceeds k.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the closed-form step cost formula for an interval containing startPos.
